_comment: Curated copy for the Selected work section. The workflow injects the volatile fields (stars, language, last push) from the API and drops any entry whose repo it cannot see. Written by hand on purpose: several of these repositories have no GitHub description, so generating this section from the API alone would replace good writing with blank cells.

projects.title: Stock Analysis
projects.body: Answers questions like "why did Tesla drop today" by splitting the work across specialised agents: ticker resolution, price retrieval, news aggregation, historical comparison, then synthesis. The unglamorous half is what makes it usable — rate limiting, caching, and health checks around two external market APIs that fail in different ways.

projects.title: Eye Gaze Tracking
projects.body: End-to-end pipeline from dataset normalisation through training to real-time cursor control off a plain webcam. Several model architectures behind one evaluation harness, because "which backbone is better" is only answerable if you can swap them without rewriting the pipeline.

projects.title: Portfolio
projects.body: A portfolio that pulls its own GitHub activity at request time rather than listing projects by hand, so it cannot quietly go stale. Dark theme, motion that stays out of the way, and a performance budget it has to keep passing.

projects.title: EcoHive
projects.body: A sustainable credit trading platform: log a verifiable green action, earn a credit, trade it. Built in a team of five under hackathon time pressure, which is where most of the actual lesson was.
